approval.statement: yep. can you make this repeatable per episode and team? locked by template and design registry?

protected.finish: satin team-color surface with fine micrograin
protected.relief: 1 broad low-contrast angular fold at the right edge; quiet center
protected.lighting: soft upper-left highlight and dark lower corners
protected.colorModel: team primary hue; highlights and shadows stay in that hue
protected.pattern: no repeating stripes; no secondary-color bands
preserve: logo art, size, position and depth
protected.reuse: 1 shared material and texture set; fixed UVs and grain seed for every team and episode

designs.revisionPolicy: A new surface look needs a new version and Jerami review. Keep prior versions for old episode renders.
